import numpy as np
def hat(x,knots):
    B=[np.ones_like(x)]
    for k in knots[1:-1]:
        B.append(np.maximum(0,x-k)**3)
    return np.array(B).T
kn=np.linspace(0.3,6,8)
BP=hat(P,kn)
for name,X in [('F+tG',np.c_[BP,BP*t[:,None]]),('F+tG+t2G',np.c_[BP,BP*t[:,None],BP*(t**2)[:,None]])]:
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    print(name,np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
# P-only and t-only
X=np.c_[BP]
c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None); print('P only',np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
X=np.c_[hat(t,np.linspace(0.5,12,8)),]
c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None); print('t only',np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
# full 2d tensor
Bt=hat(t,np.linspace(0.5,12,6))
X=np.einsum('ni,nj->nij',Bt,BP).reshape(len(t),-1)
c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None); print('2D',np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
